name: Polymyositis
definition: Acquired inflammatory myopathy characterized by predominantly symmetric proximal muscle weakness after exclusion of better-defined inflammatory myopathy subtypes.

investigations.principle: Muscle enzymes, autoantibodies, MRI, EMG and biopsy are selected according to phenotype.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Diagnosis should not be used loosely; modern classification requires exclusion of other inflammatory myopathies.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Bala-kshaya phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Acquired inflammatory myopathy characterized by predominantly symmetric proximal muscle weakness after exclusion of better-defined inflammatory myopathy subtypes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
